name: rmia_p12_itransformer
_comment: RMIA pipeline on P12 + iTransformer (feasibility config, non-DP): 4 complementary model pairs (8 models), each trained on half of set-a (n=3992, so ~1996 patients/model); audit set 1600 (balanced for target 0) drawn from set-a; population = 1600 patients from set-b (held-out test split). flip=false: P12 is tabular time-series, not images (random_hflip would crash on this shape).
